# HP70923 evidence fixtures

70923.atom reconstructs the real collector format from the frozen production title/content/URL/update fields; it is not archived feed bytes.
70923.html is a minimal deterministic reconstruction of the official hearing document table, with actual draft URL/title plus unrelated links for boundary tests.
70923-draft-pages.pdf contains unedited official PDF pages 1,39,107,112 extracted using pypdf; extraction and provenance run in tests, not manually supplied classifier text. Page39 contains the country-list context. Pages107/112 exercise current-law appendix exclusion.
Full original PDF is kept outside the repository in the Phase1.61.4 impact artifacts. Fixture pages are an excerpt, not a complete source document.
